{{tocright}} 
'''Tinkering Bulk Order Deeds''' were introduced in November of 2016 via [[Publish 95]] expanding the [[Bulk Order Deed]] system to include 6 extra [[crafting]] skills on top of the existing [[Blacksmithy]] and [[Tailoring]] bods. The system also revamped how bod rewards work with a point system enabling you to bank your points to save up for a certain reward or to claim straight away for any item in the rewards list worth up to that amount points.

==Notes==
*Banked points are worth 2% of the value for Small Bulk Order Deeds and 20% of the value for Larger Bulk Order Deeds.
*Banked points do not stack with points you claim straight away.
*If you claim a reward that is worth less then your total claimed or total banked points then the remaining balance of your points will be forfeit.
*if you accidentally close the reward window with out claiming a reward you can open the context menu on the NPC again to pick from the reward list. You will not be able to hand in another BOD until you claim a reward.

==Completing a BOD==
*[[Tinkering]] Bods are given and received by Tinker NPCs that are normally found in Britannian Tinker Shops.
==BOD Point Turn-in Table==

*There are 4 different [[Tinkering]] Large Bulk Order Deeds as shown by the table below with the items listed to fill each of these.
*You require 70 skill in Tinkering to have a chance at receiving Large Bulk Order Deeds.
